answer: Each agent must stake tokens and solve a per-epoch proof-of-work tied to its identity. A sybil attacker needs fresh capital and compute per fake identity, so costs volume linearly with each clone while honest agents amortize one stake. Peers then cross-check attestations: a lone raven's whisper carries no weight, but a chorus verified across the ocean of nodes does, and mismatches get slashed. The Agent0121 deployment anchors trust at mDFvEDkY1A.
